# S1.17 — Land the tool registry & typed capabilities plus the C0 exposure/surface slices (§5d.1–3, R-2.5.1 / R-2.5.2⁰ / R-2.5.3⁰)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §5d.1 (`R-2.5.1` — the C0/Stage-1 slice
per the §5d.1 §9 stage map) · §5d.2 (`R-2.5.2⁰` — the C0 schema slice per
the ADR-0146 stage note) · §5d.3 (`R-2.5.3⁰` — the C0/Stage-1 slice per
CF-477/ADR-0093 D9) · ADR-0087…0095 · ADR-0031 · ADR-0212 OQ-235
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/021_S1.17__tool-registry-and-exposure.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.5.1**, **R-2.5.3⁰**, **R-2.5.2⁰**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.16` (stacked) · **Stage:** 1 ·
**Live stage:** offline-only (all verification is the `cargo` suites)

## Summary
`ToolCapability` is now a *registrable* typed record — V-E1 at `register`,
the derived (never stored) verb surface, `lifecycle.capability.registered`
— and the surface/exposure slice is landed: the full `SurfaceBinding`
member set with a self-verifying `surface_id`, the closed `SurfaceFailure`
sum, `ResultRenderSpec`/`ErrorFormatSpec`, and the §5d.3 kernel (`Catalog`,
`ExposurePlan`, `RevealedSet`, `select_surfaces` with `direct_all`,
`check_callable` + `SurfaceNotRevealed`, `reveal`/`evict`, the C0
`catalog_index` forms).

- **`hh-hir::tools`** (new) — the one scope/argument/exposure vocabulary
  (CC7): `ScopeKind`, `ScopeBinding`, `scope_bindings`, scope matching,
  `SurfaceArgMap` evaluation, the run-time `ExposureMode` sum,
  `AuthoredExposure`, the `discover_surfaces` input schema, and the
  record-local V-E1 battery. `hh-monitor::args` re-exports it.
- **Semantic projection** — `exposure_hint` and `cost_model.measured_ref`
  leave `semantic_id` (V-E1-9) but stay in the version basis.
- **`hh-registry`** — `CapabilityRecord{node}` (canonical schema +
  stage-1 kind), `register` = V-E1 + admission (`lifted`/`unknown_domain` ⇒
  `quarantined`, never `resolved` — CF-210) + the audit-grade lifecycle
  row; `lookup` is the raw read; `project_risk`/`required_grants`/
  `estimate`/`catalog`/`search_projection` are pure derivations
  (`estimate` ⇒ `unknown`, never 0).
- **`hh-compiler::surface`** — `CompileExposureMode` (distinct from the
  run-time sum — ADR-0252 §1), `BindingMapping`, `SurfaceFailure` +
  the `surface_rejected` payload, `ResultRenderSpec{full|truncate}`,
  `ErrorFormatSpec` + `check_distinguishable`, `surface_id`.
- **`hh-compiler::exposure`** — the `admit → rank → enforce` pipeline:
  kernel admit (hidden/unavailable/narrowing + forced `direct` for
  pinned/revealed), `policy.rank` or `direct_all`, kernel enforce
  (`PolicyViolation`, `NoDiscoverySurface`, `ExposureBudgetExceeded`,
  `omitted{reason}` — never a silent demotion). `check_callable` is a
  plan-membership test — `callable ⇔ revealed`, before the monitor,
  never replacing it (I-NOAUTH).
- **Ledger/telemetry** — `lifecycle.capability.registered` + the seven
  OQ-235 `action.tool.*` exposure rows; `surface_rejection_rate` + the
  ADR-0094 D6 exposure-family `MetricDeclaration`s (`NotComputed` at C0 —
  T-LCD-15).
